name: @tunglt1810/figma-mcp-go

tools.name: apply_style_to_node
tools.description: Apply a local style to a node.

tools.name: batch_execute_pipeline
tools.description: Run write steps in order. A step can use earlier results through $variables. With stop_on_error, a failure undoes created nodes and changed properties, but not deletes, group/ungroup, detach, reparent, or steps that target nodes by name.

steps.description: Steps in order: {id, action, params, export_vars?}

action.description: Tool name to run e.g. create_frame

id.description: Step ID, used by $variables in later steps

stop_on_error.description: Stop and undo on error (default true)

tools.name: batch_rename_nodes
tools.description: Rename nodes: set `name`, or find/replace (regex allowed), or prefix/suffix. `name` cannot mix with the others.

find.description: Text or regex to find in names

name.description: New name for all nodes. A slash makes a group, e.g. 'Icons/Arrow'.

tools.name: boolean_operation
tools.description: Combine 2+ shapes (same parent): UNION, SUBTRACT (cut the rest from the first), INTERSECT, or EXCLUDE. Pipeline rollback cannot undo it.

nodeIds.description: Shape IDs. Order matters for SUBTRACT.

tools.name: clone_node
tools.description: Copy a node, optionally to a new position or parent.

tools.name: combine_as_variants
tools.description: Combine 2+ components (same parent) into a variant set. Add VARIANT properties with manage_component_properties.

tools.name: create_component
tools.description: Turn a FRAME into a COMPONENT, in place.

tools.name: create_component_instance
tools.description: Create an instance of a local (componentId) or library (componentKey) component. A component set uses its default variant.

tools.name: create_connector
tools.description: Create a connector line. This tool operates only in a FigJam file.

tools.name: create_node
tools.description: Create a shape. Args per `type`: FRAME: width, height, fillColor, auto layout args. RECTANGLE: width, height, fillColor, cornerRadius. ELLIPSE: width, height, fillColor, startAngle, endAngle, innerRadiusRatio. STAR: pointCount, outerRadius, innerRadius, fillColor, cornerRadius. POLYGON: pointCount, radius, fillColor, cornerRadius. LINE: length, rotation, strokeColor, strokeWeight. SECTION: width, height (no parent). All: x, y, name. The tool rejects other args. For text, use create_text.

counterAxisAlignItems.description: Cross axis align: MIN, CENTER, MAX, BASELINE

counterAxisSizingMode.description: Cross axis size: FIXED or AUTO (hug)

layoutAlign.description: This node's cross axis align in the parent's auto layout

layoutGrow.description: 1 = grow to fill the parent's main axis, 0 = keep size

layoutMode.description: Auto layout: HORIZONTAL, VERTICAL, or NONE

layoutPositioning.description: In the parent's auto layout: AUTO (in flow) or ABSOLUTE (free, at x/y)

layoutSizingHorizontal.description: Width mode: FIXED, HUG (fit content), or FILL (fill parent). Prefer this over *AxisSizingMode. HUG needs auto layout on this node. FILL needs auto layout on its parent.

layoutSizingVertical.description: Height mode: FIXED, HUG, or FILL. The rules are the same as for layoutSizingHorizontal.

primaryAxisAlignItems.description: Main axis align: MIN, CENTER, MAX, SPACE_BETWEEN

primaryAxisSizingMode.description: Main axis size: FIXED or AUTO (hug)

type.description: FRAME, RECTANGLE, ELLIPSE, STAR, POLYGON, LINE, or SECTION

tools.name: create_style
tools.description: Create a local style. Args per `type`: PAINT: color. TEXT: fontSize, fontFamily, fontStyle, textDecoration, lineHeightValue/Unit, letterSpacingValue/Unit. EFFECT: effectType, color, opacity, radius, offsetX, offsetY, spread. GRID: pattern, count, gutterSize, offset, alignment, sectionSize, color, opacity. The tool returns the style ID. Apply the style with apply_style_to_node.

color.description: Hex. PAINT: required. EFFECT: default #000000. GRID: default #FF0000.

name.description: Style name. A slash makes a group, e.g. 'Brand/Primary'.

tools.name: create_text
tools.description: Create a text node (loads the font). To edit text, use set_text.

fontStyle.description: Font style e.g. 'Bold' (default Regular). The style must exist for the family.

tools.name: create_vector
tools.description: Create a vector from SVG markup (e.g. an icon). Several paths become a frame of vectors.

tools.name: delete_nodes
tools.description: Delete nodes. You cannot undo this from here.

tools.name: delete_style
tools.description: Delete a style by ID.

tools.name: detach_instance
tools.description: Detach instances into plain frames (same look, no component link).

tools.name: export_frames_to_pdf
tools.description: Export frames as one PDF, one page per frame, in order.

outputPath.description: Path of the .pdf file, inside the working directory

tools.name: export_screenshots
tools.description: Export nodes as images. The tool saves items with outputPath to file. It returns the other items (PNG/JPG as image, SVG as text, PDF as base64). Without items, the tool exports the selection. Prefer outputPath if you only need the file.

format.description: Default format: PNG (default), SVG, JPG, PDF

items.description: {nodeId, outputPath?, format?, scale?}. Omit to export the selection.

outputPath.description: File to save to. Omit to return the image.

scale.description: Default scale for PNG/JPG (2 for files, 1 when returned)

tools.name: export_tokens
tools.description: Export variables and paint styles as JSON or CSS variables.

tools.name: find_replace_text
tools.description: Find and replace text in TEXT nodes, on the current page or inside nodeId.

nodeId.description: Search inside this node (default: current page)

tools.name: flatten_nodes
tools.description: Merge nodes (same parent) into one vector. Pipeline rollback cannot undo it.

tools.name: get_annotations
tools.description: Get Dev Mode annotations on the page, or on one node and its children.

nodeId.description: Only this node and its children

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Get the node tree of the selection, page, or file (`scope`). The tool returns {fileName, scope, currentPage, nodes}. The tool stops at 500 nodes by default. It then sets `truncated`, and nodes with hidden children show `childCount`.

dedupe_components.description: Show instances in short form (mainComponentId, componentProperties, overrides) and list each component once in `componentDefs`. This saves tokens on screens with many instances.

depth.description: Levels below each root. 0 = root only. Default 2 for selection, no limit otherwise.

detail.description: minimal: id/name/type/bounds. compact: + fills/strokes/opacity. full (default): everything. Use lower levels for big files.

maxNodes.description: Max nodes (default 500). It does not apply with depth, a lower `detail`, or dedupe_components.

scope.description: page (default): current page. document: every page, one shared maxNodes limit. selection: selected nodes, 2 levels deep by default, or the page if the selection is empty. Use selection to explore.

tools.name: get_fonts
tools.description: List fonts used on the current page, most used first.

tools.name: get_image_bytes
tools.description: Get the original image files in nodes' image fills, as base64. The tool returns each image once. Nodes without images go in `skipped`. To see how a node looks, use export_screenshots.

tools.name: get_instance_overrides
tools.description: Get an instance's component properties with type and value. Use this tool before set_instance_overrides.

tools.name: get_local_components
tools.description: Get all components in the file.

tools.name: get_metadata
tools.description: Get file name, current page, and all pages (ID, name). The tool loads no node trees.

tools.name: get_nodes_info
tools.description: Get full node details by ID. The tool returns {nodes}, plus globalVars.styles for repeated fills/strokes. Unknown IDs go in `missing`. The tool stops at 500 descendants by default. It then sets `truncated` and `childCount`.

depth.description: Levels below each node. 0 = the nodes only. Default no limit.

tools.name: get_reactions
tools.description: Get a node's prototype reactions (trigger + actions). Edit them with set_reactions.

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: Get selected nodes, or nodes pinned in the plugin panel. The result is [] if there are none. For detail, use get_nodes_info.

source.description: selection (default): the nodes selected now. It changes when the user clicks. pinned: the set saved in the panel. It stays the same across calls.

tools.name: get_styles
tools.description: Get local styles (paint, text, effect, grid) with ID, name, type, values. For variables, use get_variable_defs.

tools.name: get_variable_defs
tools.description: Get local variables (design tokens): collections, modes, values.

tools.name: get_viewport
tools.description: Get viewport center, zoom, and visible bounds.

tools.name: group_nodes
tools.description: Group 2+ nodes that share a parent.

tools.name: import_image
tools.description: Add an image from a URL (preferred) or base64, as a rectangle sized to the image, or as nodeId's fill.

crop.description: Part of the image to show, {x, y, width, height} each 0-1. This sets scaleMode to CROP.

imageData.description: Base64 PNG or JPG, if no URL

mode.description: With nodeId: replace fills (default) or append

nodeId.description: Fill this node with the image instead of making a rectangle

tools.name: manage_component_properties
tools.description: Add, edit, delete, or bind component properties. bind links a layer: BOOLEAN shows/hides it, TEXT sets its text, INSTANCE_SWAP swaps it. Names work without the '#1:2' suffix.

defaultValue.description: Default, for add: boolean, string, or component ID (INSTANCE_SWAP)

type.description: Type, for add. VARIANT needs a COMPONENT_SET.

tools.name: manage_page
tools.description: Add, delete, rename, or go to a page. Args per `action`: add: name, index. delete, navigate: pageId or pageName. rename: pageId or pageName, newName. List pages with get_metadata.

pageName.description: Exact page name, instead of pageId

tools.name: manage_plugin_data
tools.description: Store string key/values on a node, saved in the file. Use JSON for complex values.

tools.name: manage_variable
tools.description: Manage variables (design tokens). Args per `action`: create_collection: name, initialModeName. add_mode: collectionId, modeName. create: name, collectionId, type, value. set_value: variableId, modeId, value. delete: variableId, or collectionId (deletes all its variables). bind: nodeId, variableId, field (node property to link). Get IDs from get_variable_defs. Free plan: 1 mode per collection. If add_mode fails with 'Limited to 1 modes only', do not retry. Put the mode in the name (e.g. 'light/bg') and tell the user multi-mode needs a paid plan.

action.description: create_collection, add_mode, create, set_value, delete, or bind

field.description: Property to bind. COLOR: fillColor, strokeColor. BOOLEAN: visible. FLOAT: opacity, rotation, width, height, cornerRadius, topLeftRadius, topRightRadius, bottomLeftRadius, bottomRightRadius, strokeWeight, itemSpacing, paddingTop, paddingRight, paddingBottom, paddingLeft.

name.description: Collection or variable name. A slash makes a group, e.g. 'Color/Primary'.

value.description: COLOR: hex. FLOAT: number. STRING: text. BOOLEAN: true/false. For create, sets the first mode.

tools.name: outline_stroke
tools.description: Turn each node's stroke into a filled shape. Nodes without a stroke go in `skipped`.

tools.name: reparent_nodes
tools.description: Move nodes into another frame, group, or section.

tools.name: save_version_checkpoint
tools.description: Save a named version in file history, before big or risky changes. This tool operates only in a Design file.

tools.name: search_nodes
tools.description: Find nodes by name, type, or both, on the current page by default. The tool returns up to `limit` nodes (default 50). It sets `truncated` if there are more.

includeHidden.description: Search hidden nodes (default true). false skips hidden nodes and their children.

includeText.description: Add characters, fontSize and fontName to TEXT results (default false).

nodeId.description: Search only inside this node. This overrides scope.

query.description: Text to find in node names (case-insensitive). Omit to match all nodes of `types`.

scope.description: page (default) or document (every page). A page search does not look at other pages.

tools.name: set_annotations
tools.description: Set Dev Mode annotations on nodes ([] clears them). The tool needs a paid Dev Mode seat.

tools.name: set_auto_layout
tools.description: Set auto layout (flexbox) on frames, components or instances: direction, padding, gap, align, sizing (HUG/FILL with layoutSizing*). layoutPositioning, layoutAlign, layoutGrow set how a node sits in its parent. Results are per node.

counterAxisAlignItems.description: Cross axis align: MIN, CENTER, MAX, BASELINE

counterAxisSizingMode.description: Cross axis size: FIXED or AUTO (hug)

layoutAlign.description: This node's cross axis align in the parent's auto layout

layoutGrow.description: 1 = grow to fill the parent's main axis, 0 = keep size

layoutMode.description: Auto layout: HORIZONTAL, VERTICAL, or NONE

layoutPositioning.description: In the parent's auto layout: AUTO (in flow) or ABSOLUTE (free, at x/y)

layoutSizingHorizontal.description: Width mode: FIXED, HUG (fit content), or FILL (fill parent). Prefer this over *AxisSizingMode. HUG needs auto layout on this node. FILL needs auto layout on its parent.

layoutSizingVertical.description: Height mode: FIXED, HUG, or FILL. The rules are the same as for layoutSizingHorizontal.

primaryAxisAlignItems.description: Main axis align: MIN, CENTER, MAX, SPACE_BETWEEN

primaryAxisSizingMode.description: Main axis size: FIXED or AUTO (hug)

tools.name: set_codegen_result
tools.description: Save code on a node for Dev Mode's Code panel. The whole team sees it. Code on a component shows on its instances. [] removes the code.

language.description: e.g. TYPESCRIPT, HTML, CSS, SWIFT, KOTLIN (default PLAINTEXT)

tools.name: set_effects
tools.description: Replace a node's effects ([] clears them), in the shape of get_nodes_info's styles.effects.

effects.description: Effects by `type`. DROP_SHADOW / INNER_SHADOW: color, opacity, offsetX, offsetY, radius, spread, blendMode, and showShadowBehindNode on drop shadows. LAYER_BLUR / BACKGROUND_BLUR: radius. blurType PROGRESSIVE adds startRadius, startOffset, endOffset as {x, y}. NOISE: noiseType (MONOTONE default | DUOTONE | MULTITONE), color, opacity, blendMode, noiseSize, density, secondaryColor for DUOTONE, noiseOpacity for MULTITONE. TEXTURE: noiseSize, radius, clipToShape. GLASS: radius, depth, lightIntensity, lightAngle, refraction, dispersion. visible defaults to true.

tools.name: set_export_settings
tools.description: Set a node's Export presets. This tool does not export. To export, use export_screenshots.

constraint.description: Size for PNG/JPG: {type: SCALE|WIDTH|HEIGHT, value}. SCALE 2 = @2x.

contentsOnly.description: Skip content that overlaps from outside (default true)

useAbsoluteBounds.description: Use full bounds even if the parent clips the node

tools.name: set_instance_overrides
tools.description: Set an instance's component properties. The tool fails on unknown names or wrong types.

properties.description: Name to value e.g. {"Size": "Large", "Show Icon": true}

tools.name: set_layout_grids
tools.description: Set layout grids (columns, rows, square) on frames. [] removes them.

tools.name: set_node_properties
tools.description: Set node properties: position, size, radius, visibility, lock, opacity, rotation, blend, constraints, z-order, mask, stroke. Pass only what changes. Results are per node.

constraints.description: {horizontal, vertical}: MIN, MAX, CENTER, STRETCH, or SCALE

isMask.description: Use as mask for the layers above it

order.description: Layer order: bringToFront, sendToBack, bringForward, sendBackward

strokeCap.description: Line ends: NONE, ROUND, SQUARE, ARROW_LINES, ARROW_EQUILATERAL

tools.name: set_paint
tools.description: Set a node's fill or stroke. SOLID: color, opacity. GRADIENT_*: stops, geometry, opacity.

geometry.description: GRADIENT: in percentX/percentY. Linear: start, end, angle. Others: center, radius, rotation.

type.description: SOLID, GRADIENT_LINEAR, GRADIENT_RADIAL, GRADIENT_ANGULAR, or GRADIENT_DIAMOND

tools.name: set_reactions
tools.description:
Set or remove prototype reactions. mode: replace (default) or append. To remove, pass removeIndices (from get_reactions, [] = all), not reactions.

Reaction: {"trigger":{"type":...},"actions":[...]}.
Triggers: ON_CLICK, ON_HOVER, ON_PRESS, ON_DRAG, AFTER_TIMEOUT (+timeout ms), MOUSE_ENTER, MOUSE_LEAVE, MOUSE_UP, MOUSE_DOWN.
Actions: NODE (+destinationId, navigation NAVIGATE|OVERLAY|SCROLL_TO|SWAP|CHANGE_TO, transition, preserveScrollPosition), BACK, CLOSE, URL (+url).
Transitions: DISSOLVE, SMART_ANIMATE, or PUSH, MOVE_IN, MOVE_OUT, SLIDE_IN, SLIDE_OUT (these also need direction LEFT|RIGHT|TOP|BOTTOM and matchLayers).
Example: {"nodeId":"1:2","reactions":[{"trigger":{"type":"ON_CLICK"},"actions":[{"type":"NODE","destinationId":"1:3","navigation":"NAVIGATE","transition":{"type":"DISSOLVE","duration":0.3,"easing":{"type":"EASE_OUT"}},"preserveScrollPosition":false}]}]}

removeIndices.description: Indices to remove. [] removes all. Do not use with reactions.

tools.name: set_selection
tools.description: Select and zoom to nodes (switches page if needed) to show the user your work. No IDs clears the selection. Nodes must share a page.

nodeIds.description: Node IDs. An empty list clears the selection.

select.description: Change selection (default true). false + zoom only moves the view.

tools.name: set_text
tools.description: Change a TEXT node's text and whole-node settings (resize, truncation, alignment, spacing). To style parts of the text, use set_text_ranges.

maxLines.description: Max lines (needs ENDING). null removes it.

textAutoResize.description: NONE (fixed), HEIGHT (grow down), WIDTH_AND_HEIGHT (hug), or TRUNCATE

tools.name: set_text_ranges
tools.description: Style parts of a TEXT node (bold, color, link, list). Each range is characters [start, end). Later ranges win on overlap. Omitted properties stay.

ranges.description: Ranges to style. Each range needs start and end.

tools.name: swap_component
tools.description: Swap an instance to another component, keeping position and size.

tools.name: ungroup_nodes
tools.description: Ungroup GROUP nodes. The children move to the parent.

tools.name: update_paint_style
tools.description: Update a paint style's name, color, or description. For other types, delete the style and create it again.
